description: This file defines the WebSocketHandshake class with cryptographic functions for WebSocket handshake processing, including SHA-1 hashing and base64 encoding.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshake
classes.description: Contains static methods and nested structs for WebSocket handshake cryptographic operations.

methods.name: rol
methods.description: Performs a bitwise rotate left operation on a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: blk
methods.description: Computes a SHA-1 message schedule word with bitwise operations.

methods.name: sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of input data.

methods.name: base64
methods.description: Encodes binary data into base64 string.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded SHA-1 hash from a 24-byte input.
